title: EM3DFold: accurate de novo protein and nucleic acid model building for cryo-EM maps using language model-powered deep learning
authors: Tao Li; Hong Cao; Sheng-You Huang
one_liner_zh: 该文提出EM3DFold，利用语言模型驱动的三轨注意力网络从冷冻电镜密度图自动构建蛋白质和核酸的原子模型，属于蛋白质结构预测与建模的核心计算研究，方法创新且性能领先。
abstract: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become one of the most powerful techniques for macromolecular structure determination. However, accurate model building from cryo-EM maps remains challenging, particularly for nucleic acids. Here, we present EM3DFold, a unified de novo model-building framework for accurate structure determination of proteins, nucleic acids, and protein-nucleic acid complexes from cryo-EM maps using a density-aware, large language model-powered three-track attention (TTA) network. The TTA network effectively integrates sequence, density, and structural information to enable accurate all-atom model building. EM3DFold was extensively evaluated on independent benchmarks of 298 experimental cryo-EM maps at < 4.0 Å resolutions, and achieves an unprecedentedly high median accuracy of 75% completeness (88% coverage and 94% sequence accuracy) for 178 nucleic acid maps, 90% completeness (95% coverage and 96% sequence accuracy) for 124 protein-nucleic acid complexes, and 95% completeness (97% coverage and 98% sequence accuracy) for 120 protein-only targets, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art methods including ModelAngelo, EM2NA, CryoREAD, and EMProt. In addition, EM3DFold also produces models with superior model-to-map fit and stereochemical quality, providing a robust and reliable solution for automated cryo-EM model building. The EM3DFold package is freely available at https://github.com/huang-laboratory/EM3DFold.
abstract_zh: 冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）已成为大分子结构测定中最强大的技术之一。然而，从冷冻电镜图谱中准确构建模型仍具挑战性，尤其是对于核酸。在此，我们提出EM3DFold，一个统一的从头模型构建框架，利用密度感知、大语言模型驱动的三轨注意力（TTA）网络，从冷冻电镜图谱中准确测定蛋白质、核酸及蛋白质-核酸复合物的结构。TTA网络有效整合序列、密度和结构信息，实现准确的全原子模型构建。EM3DFold在298个分辨率<4.0 Å的实验冷冻电镜图谱的独立基准上进行了广泛评估，并在178个核酸图谱中实现了前所未有的75%完整度（88%覆盖率和94%序列准确率）的中位准确度，在124个蛋白质-核酸复合物中达到90%完整度（95%覆盖率和96%序列准确率），在120个纯蛋白质靶标中达到95%完整度（97%覆盖率和98%序列准确率），显著优于包括ModelAngelo、EM2NA、CryoREAD和EMProt在内的最先进方法。此外，EM3DFold还生成具有优异模型-图谱拟合度和立体化学质量的模型，为自动化冷冻电镜模型构建提供了稳健可靠的解决方案。EM3DFold软件包可在https://github.com/huang-laboratory/EM3DFold免费获取。
